title: Forward Substitution
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Math Functions/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Linear System Solvers/Forward_Substitution.md
text: Solve L X = B for X when L is lower triangular matrix, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Method of rounding operation; {Input L is unit-lower triangular} sets the diagonal elements of input matrix have a value, {Diagonal of complex input L is real} sets the diagonal elements of complex input are, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Product output}, {Accumulator}, {Output}, {Output Minimum} sets the minimum value the block can output, {Output Maximum} sets the maximum value block can output and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.
